_comment: MovieNet-derived operating points, used as fixed thresholds for out-of-distribution (AI-gen) evaluation. val_thr = F1-optimal on MovieNet val; tau99 = 99th percentile of within-shot variation (the deployable threshold). Sourced from outputs/v0/results.json, outputs/v0_mean_pool/results.json, outputs/calibration/calibration.json, and reports/v1_calibration.md. mean_pool has no tau99 -- within-shot calibration was run only for the deployed scorers, so F1@tau99 is left blank for the mean-pool-3 ablation.
